commitments.detail: The metallurgist will present their current assessment of the housings.
The process engineer will present their current assessment of the housings.
The quality director will record the agreed rework, testing, and records actions before signing the disposition decision.
The process engineer will review the metallurgist's assessment and agree on the rework plan.
The metallurgist and process engineer will present their current assessments.
The production team will perform rework at 850°C for 60 minutes and conduct 100% hardness testing.
All records related to this lot will be retained for 5 years.
The metallurgist will provide an assessment on the affected housings.
The process engineer will provide an assessment on the affected housings.
